staging model: staging.stg_orders (the view that cleans and maps region_name)
mart model: marts.fct_orders (the downstream fact table where the nulls appear)

args.evidence: marts.fct_orders has 1892 null region_name rows; these correspond to orders whose customer_key missing in marts.dim_customers (missing_cust=1892). marts.dim_customers has 1319 rows vs staging.stg_customers 1500 rows, indicating 181 customers dropped due to inner joins on stg_nations and stg_regions. This suggests missing or mismatched nation/region keys in the raw.nation (or raw.region) source, causing customers to be excluded upstream. Since the nulls stem from missing source reference data, the issue is upstream data and should be escalated to the source owner.
